title: Shannon Entropy Characterization
abstract: Formalizes Shannon's finite-alphabet characterization theorem for entropy from the 1948 paper.

informal.LeanPool.Shannon1948Formalization.entrop: Proves that any finite-alphabet uncertainty functional satisfying Shannon's conditions equals natural-log entropy up to a positive scale.
Restates the characterization for any logarithm base greater than one.
Proves the converse, showing that Shannon entropy satisfies the formal condition bundle.
informal.LeanPool.Shannon1948Formalization.chain_: Proves the finite joint-entropy chain rule.
informal.LeanPool.Shannon1948Formalization.entrop: Proves subadditivity of finite joint entropy.
